column1: # smart-knowledge.tsv -- the SMART table: problems of the disk itself
# #1921 (Nadav 20/10, final). One row a line, TAB-separated, '-' = empty. Read by the agent
# (agent/lib/smartjudge.sh, awk) and by the server (server/smart_names.py) -- the same file.
# kind: ata (id + the name smartctl printed) | devstat | nvme | nvmebit | selftest | errlog | hw
# field: raw | value (normalized) | temp (raw degrees C) ; op/value: the rule, '-' = none (info)
# value 'crc' = the crc_warn_threshold setting (default 500); 'wctemp' = the NVMe disk's own WCTEMP
# verdict when the rule holds: orange | red | hw | info ; a name in neither table = 'לא מוכר'
# word: the reason word the agent stores (smart.sh SMART_WARN_REASONS) ; media: ssd|hdd|any
